about.headline: About Riyad Ketami
about.subheadline: AI educator, digital strategist, and content creator — building the bridge between global AI and the MENA creator economy.
about.identity_title: I work where culture, technology, and execution meet.
identity: I'm Riyad Ketami. I help people use AI to build something real.

I do that on stage, in rooms with global brands, in workshops with founders, and every day on my channels — in front of a community that's grown into the millions across North Africa, the Arab world, and the Francophone diaspora.

I started as a designer. I became a strategist. Now I'm an operator — shipping content, shipping partnerships, shipping products. AI is the lever. MENA is the market the rest of the world keeps underestimating. Bridging both is the work.
